Reranking where the provider lists the scored documents under data instead of results

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_rerank_async(client, "{\"documents\":[\"The weather is sunny today.\",\"Deep learning uses neural networks.\",\"Machine learning is a subset of AI.\"],\"model\":\"voyage/rerank-2\",\"query\":\"What is machine learning?\"}")
IO.inspect(result.results)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).relevance_score)
```
